pages.title: Terrace dining | Hotel Miramar
blocks: The west terrace at
serves hotel residents, visitors and private-event guests. Sea views are included. The sea has declined to accept reservations.
Terrace service runs from breakfast until eleven in the evening. Please check with reception when a private function is taking place.
Lunches, afternoon drinks and group dinners are available. Our staff can arrange tables for small parties or larger receptions.
Please do not feed the seagulls. They have already reviewed the menu and consider themselves entitled to everything on it.
pages.snippet: West-terrace dining, afternoon drinks and private-event service.

pages.title: Before your stay | Miramar guest questions
blocks: DO I NEED A ROOM TO VISIT THE TERRACE?
No.
welcomes non-residents for dining and drinks, subject to availability and private functions.
CAN I ASK WHETHER SOMEONE IS STAYING WITH YOU?
We do not publish guest lists, room allocations or private bookings. Please contact the person directly. Looking concerned while holding a notebook does not change this policy.
WHAT IF I LEFT SOMETHING BEHIND?
Contact reception with a description, the approximate date and where you last saw it. “My dignity, near the dance floor” is unfortunately outside our storage policy.
pages.snippet: Terrace visits, guest privacy and the lost-property cupboard.

pages.title: Hotel Miramar | Coastline visitor guide
blocks: is a seafront hotel offering accommodation, terrace dining and meeting facilities. Its traditional seahorse crest appears on the hotel’s own website.
The terrace also serves visitors who are not staying overnight. Check directly with the hotel before making a special journey, particularly when events are scheduled.
This is a visitor listing, not a booking register. We can help you find somewhere to stay, not establish where your brother-in-law was last Thursday.
Our directory also lists The Mariner and Coral Crown Hotel. Please check the property name before sending a complaint about the swimming pool.
pages.snippet: Seafront accommodation, terrace dining and meeting facilities. Check details with the hotel.

pages.title: Hotel Miramar — worth visiting just for the terrace?
blocks: SALT_AND_PEPPER: “Can you visit the Miramar terrace without booking a room? I want lunch, not a mortgage.”
WEEKEND_WANDERER: “Yes, we went for drinks. Check with the hotel first if they have a private function.”
BISCUIT_INSPECTOR: “Nice view. A gull maintained eye contact with my sandwich for the entire meal. Very attentive service, wrong employee.”
HAND_LUGGAGE_ONLY: “Make sure you mean the hotel. My cousin arranged to meet us at the Miramar cinema. We gave the lunch four stars; he gave the film two.”
MODERATOR: “Hotel reviews only. No naming other guests or speculating about who they were with. The gull may be identified by its lack of remorse.”
pages.snippet: Lunch, sea views and one deeply committed sandwich thief.

pages.title: Miramar Picture House | Films & ticket information
blocks: MIRAMAR PICTURE HOUSE — an independent cinema on Station Road.
Two screens, evening showings and a concessions counter with strong opinions about outside snacks. This is a cinema, not Hotel Miramar.
Seat reservations are available at the box office. We cannot reserve a seat on the hotel terrace, although several callers have asked with admirable persistence.
Please switch off mobile phones during the film. Whispering “I am in the cinema” does not count as switching it off.
pages.snippet: Independent cinema on Station Road. Film tickets, not hotel rooms.
